ci_status_policy_content:
# CI status policy

`ACMM F4-B Required Validation` is the required blocking workflow for this candidate. `ACMM F4-B Advisory Signal` is informational and non-blocking. Only the required-workflow result for the pull request's current head determines whether `ci-blocked` is warranted. Historical runs remain audit evidence. When an alert refers to a superseded required failure but the current required run passes, remove `ci-blocked`, add `ci-resolved`, leave one resolution comment identifying the superseded failure and current successful required run while noting that the advisory failure is non-blocking, then close the alert issue. Do not modify code, workflows, branches, pull-request state, or Actions state.

alert_issue.title: CI alert: required candidate validation is failing
alert_issue.body: Track the required validation failure observed on the earlier candidate head. Reconcile this alert against current CI evidence and repository policy.

ci_resolved_label.name: ci-resolved
ci_resolved_label.description: The tracked required CI alert has been reconciled as resolved.
